label: FLT3-ITD
notes: ITD length and allelic ratio are both ELN 2022 risk inputs; general-purpose SNV callers split these into multiple small indels; ITDs run from about 3 bp upward, but below 12 bp a tandem match to adjacent reference occurs often enough by chance that the calls cannot be told from basecalling indels: on one sample a 6 bp floor produced 17 verified duplications against 2 at 12 bp, several carrying more read support than the real ITD. Tandem identity also scales with length

label: UBTF-TD
notes: exon 13 tandem duplication producing a HOXA/HOXB expression signature; no fusion partner exists

label: KMT2A-PTD
notes: classically exons 2-8 or 2-10; invisible to KMT2A break-apart FISH because both breakpoints are intragenic

label: MYB-dup
notes: intragenic duplication at 6q23 as an alternative to TRB::MYB

label: PAX5-amp
notes: intragenic amplification, usually exons 2-5, defining for the PAX5amp subtype of B-ALL; distinct from PAX5alt rearrangement and from PAX5 P80R, and invisible to a break-apart probe because both breakpoints lie inside the gene
